subject.title: Discord: Support messageUpdate and messageDelete events for edit-to-reprocess and delete-to-cancel

question: Should Discord message edits automatically supersede prior runs and should deleting the source message cancel the exact run it started by default?
rationale: The missing source path is clear, but the proposed fix changes channel/session control semantics for existing Discord users and the active PR makes that behavior default-on.

options.title: Adopt linked PR semantics
options.body: Proceed with the active PR after its debounce-window cancellation blocker is fixed and live Discord proof confirms edit and delete behavior.

options.title: Narrow to edit handling
options.body: Land edit-to-reprocess first and leave delete-to-cancel for a separate session-state decision.

options.title: Require opt-in behavior
options.body: Ask for a default-preserving config or migration story before enabling edit/delete control for existing Discord users.

recommendation.title: Adopt linked PR semantics
recommendation.body: Proceed with the active PR after its debounce-window cancellation blocker is fixed and live Discord proof confirms edit and delete behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: His recent Discord internals and run-queue refactors make him the strongest current-main history owner for deciding the channel boundary and session semantics.
